results.title: Full Stack React Application Developer
results.description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Full Stack React Application Developer to build production-grade, data-rich web applications, APIs, and interactive dashboards. You will own the full application lifecycle from designing component architectures and building performant React frontends to creating robust backend APIs and integrating with data platforms.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will build applications used by senior leadership, operations teams, and business users. The ideal candidate combines deep React expertise with strong API development skills and enough data fluency to work effectively with data engineering teams.

React Frontend Development (Primary Focus)

• Architect, build, and maintain complex React applications — dashboards, analytics platforms, internal tools, and customer-facing products

• Develop responsive, mobile-first UIs optimized for tablet (iPad) and desktop with pixel-perfect execution

• Build rich data visualizations using D3.js, Recharts, Chart.js, or custom SVG/Canvas components

• Implement advanced state management patterns using Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query, or Context API

• Create reusable, well-documented component libraries with design system integration (Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, or CSS Modules)

• Optimise frontend performance: code splitting, lazy loading, memoisation, virtual scrolling, bundle analysis

• Write comprehensive tests using Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress for E2E testing

• Implement real-time features using WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, or polling strategies

API Design & Backend Development

• Design and build RESTful APIs using Node.js (Express/Fastify) or Python (FastAPI/Flask) following OpenAPI specifications

• Develop GraphQL APIs where appropriate for complex data querying needs

• Implement authentication and authorisation (OAuth 2.0, JWT, RBAC) for secure API access

• Build middleware for logging, rate limiting, caching, error handling, and request validation

• Design database schemas and write efficient queries (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar)

• Implement API versioning, pagination, filtering, and search capabilities

• Build and maintain microservices or serverless functions (Azure Functions / AWS Lambda)

• Create API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI and maintain developer-facing docs

Integration & Data Layer

• Integrate frontend applications with data platforms (Databricks, data warehouses, data lakes) through API layers

• Build data ingestion endpoints that accept, validate, transform, and store incoming data

• Work with data engineers to consume curated datasets and serve them through optimised APIs

• Implement caching strategies (Redis, CDN, browser cache) for high-performance data delivery

• Connect to third-party services and APIs (payment gateways, CRM, loyalty platforms, analytics tools)

AI / LLM Integration

• Build conversational AI interfaces (chatbots, knowledge agents) using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI)

• Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns for document Q&A and contextual search

• Create prompt engineering frameworks and manage AI response streaming in React UIs

DevOps & Delivery

• Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI)

• Containerize applications with Docker and deploy to Kubernetes or cloud-managed services

• Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability (Datadog, New Relic, or Application Insights)

• Conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and drive engineering best practices

### Requirements

**Must-Have Skills**

• 5–7 years of professional full stack development experience in a product engineering environment

• Expert-level React.js (4+ years): hooks, context, suspense, server components, performance patterns

• Strong TypeScript proficiency — type-safe component development, generics, utility types

• Production experience building and consuming REST APIs (Node.js with Express/Fastify or Python with FastAPI)

• Solid database skills: PostgreSQL or MySQL (schema design, indexing, query optimisation) and/or MongoDB

• Experience with modern CSS: Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, or Styled Components for scalable styling

• Proficiency with Git, branching strategies, PR workflows, and collaborative development

• Experience with cloud platforms: Azure (preferred) or AWS — app hosting, serverless, storage, CDN

• Strong understanding of web security: CORS, XSS, CSRF, CSP, authentication flows

• Experience with Docker containerisation and basic Kubernetes or cloud-managed container services

• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and working in cross-functional, distributed teams

**Good-to-Have Skills**

• Experience with Next.js (App Router, SSR, ISR, API routes) or Remix

• GraphQL development experience (Apollo Server/Client or similar)

• Data visualisation expertise: D3.js, Recharts, Plotly, custom charting

• Experience integrating with LLM/AI APIs and building AI-powered features

• Knowledge of Databricks, Apache Spark, or data lake/warehouse concepts

• Experience with real-time systems: WebSockets, Kafka consumers, event-driven architecture

• Familiarity with design tools (Figma) and design-to-code workflows

• Understanding of retail / e-commerce domain (POS, loyalty, customer analytics)

• Experience with Storybook for component documentation and visual testing

• Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and internationalisation (i18n)

**Education**

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field

• Relevant certifications are a plus: AWS/Azure Developer, Meta React Certification, or similar

We’re passionate about technology, but even more about the people behind it. If you’re looking for an environment where your ideas matter, experimentation is encouraged, and your impact is tangible, welcome to Darwoft.

### About the Role

We’re looking for a **Senior Fullstack Engineer with a strong frontend focus** to join a high-impact international FinTech project building an internal **Customer Experience Operations Platform**.

The platform provides the tools customer experience agents and supervisors rely on every day to manage **queues, assignments, conversations, agent availability, dashboards, metrics, and operational workflows**.

You’ll primarily design and ship agent-facing experiences using **React and TypeScript**, working within a modern, modular frontend architecture while collaborating closely with the backend services and APIs that power the platform.

A key aspect of this opportunity is the way the team approaches software development.

We’re looking for engineers with an **agentic development mindset**: people who actively use **AI coding assistants, LLM agents, automation, and AI-assisted engineering workflows** to prototype faster, solve problems, generate and validate code, improve testing, accelerate debugging, and increase overall engineering productivity.

This is not simply about using AI autocomplete. We’re looking for engineers who are comfortable incorporating tools such as **Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, coding agents, custom scripts, or AI-assisted specifications** into their day-to-day development process while maintaining strong engineering judgment and ownership.

You’ll work closely with Product, CX stakeholders, designers, and backend engineers to turn operational requirements into reliable, intuitive, and scalable user experiences.

### What You’ll Be Doing

- Design, develop, and maintain **React / TypeScript** features across CX domain modules, including operations tooling, agent presence, inbox workflows, queues, assignments, and internal applications.
- Build and evolve reusable **UI components, forms, tables, filters, dashboards, and complex operational workflows**.
- Work with technologies and patterns including **Tailwind CSS, Tremor, Radix/shadcn, and Storybook**.
- Apply **AI-assisted and agentic software engineering practices** to accelerate prototyping, implementation, testing, refactoring, documentation, and debugging.
- Experiment with AI coding agents and automated workflows to improve engineering productivity and development quality.
- Build data-driven interfaces using **TanStack Query, React Router, react-hook-form, and Zod**.
- Integrate frontend applications with **BFF and backend APIs**.
- Work within a **micro-frontend architecture using Rspack and Module Federation**, respecting domain boundaries and monorepo conventions.
- Collaborate on API design and integration with **FastAPI backend services**, including OpenAPI contracts and BFF endpoints.
- Ensure end-to-end correctness across workflows involving queues, agents, assignments, conversations, and operational metrics.
- Contribute to authorization-aware UX aligned with gateway permissions and domain-level capability models.
- Troubleshoot issues across the **frontend BFF backend** stack using both traditional debugging techniques and AI-assisted workflows.
- Ensure the reliability, accessibility, and performance of agent-critical workflows running in production.
- Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, technical decision-making, and engineering best practices around **type safety, linting, testing, and maintainability**.

### What You Bring

- **8+ years of software engineering experience**, with a strong frontend-oriented background.
- Strong production experience with **React and TypeScript**.
- Hands-on experience actively using **AI development tools and agentic workflows** such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, coding agents, AI-assisted specifications, or similar tooling.
- Ability to use AI as part of the engineering workflow while maintaining ownership over architecture, code quality, testing, and technical decisions.
- Experience building complex product interfaces involving **forms, tables, filters, dashboards, and multi-step workflows**.
- Strong understanding of modern frontend development practices and component-driven architectures.
- Experience with modern bundlers such as **Webpack, Rspack, or Vite**.
- Experience with **Tailwind CSS** or similar modern styling frameworks.
- Experience consuming **REST APIs** and working with **OpenAPI-based services**.
- Ability to debug and troubleshoot issues across frontend and backend boundaries.
- Experience with modern state management and server-state patterns such as **TanStack Query, React Context, and hooks**.
- Strong debugging, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills.
- Ability to collaborate effectively with **Product, Engineering, and operational stakeholders**.
- Advanced English proficiency, both spoken and written.

### Nice to Have

- Experience designing or integrating **AI-agent workflows, AI-powered interfaces, or automated support operations**.
- Experience with **micro-frontend** or **Module Federation**.
- Experience working with **monorepos** using pnpm, Turbo, Nx, or similar tools.
- Familiarity with **Refine, react-intl**, or admin/operations-focused internal platforms.
- Experience developing **BFF layers with Node.js / Fastify**.
- Experience with **Python / FastAPI**, particularly the ability to understand APIs, propose schema changes, or implement small backend endpoints.
- Experience working with **PostgreSQL-backed services** and transactional or domain-oriented APIs.
- Experience in **FinTech, payments, remittances, customer support platforms, or high-volume operational systems**.
- Experience with **GCP**, including technologies such as OIDC or Pub/Sub.
- Experience with **Docker** and CI/CD in cloud-native environments.
- Familiarity with **Storybook, Vitest, and design-system workflows**.
- Experience working in fast-moving **startup or scale-up environments**.

### What Darwoft Offers

- Contractor agreement with payment in USD
- 100% remote work
- Argentina's public holidays
- English classes
- Referral program
- Access to learning platforms

results.title: Full-Stack Developer (React + Typescript + Sql) | Ai-First Product Studio | Remote (Latam)
results.description:
### Core Requirements

- Python / FastAPI (Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, Alembic)
- React and/or TypeScript
- AWS and/or GCP
- Strong SQL/BigQuery experience.
- Strong testing practices and high test coverage.
- Hands-on experience with FHIR R4 and HL7 v2.x and/or C-CDA.
- Healthcare experience, particularly HIPAA/PHI.

A **healthcare background** and knowledge of **interoperability standards** are preferred, but initially, we’re open to considering candidates who don’t have this experience if they are technically very strong.

The interview process would be:

- HR screening
- English test
- Technical interview

Our client is a remote product studio that builds MVPs and custom software for startups and companies past the idea stage. Clients hire them for a fixed-scope MVP or for a product team billed by the two-week sprint, and the whole team uses AI coding tools every day.

They've been at it since 2020 and were profitable in 2025, with a 30% net margin. After building their own AI systems, they tripled monthly revenue with the same team size. Clients rate them 4.9 out of 5 in verified reviews, and the startups they build for have raised more than $25M in venture funding.

### Your Role

You'll join the team building workflow software for one of the studio's clients: a live product that needs new workflow features while the existing ones keep running. The client's own engineers commit to the same repo, so every new table, permission and workflow goes in next to code someone else is changing. The weight is on the server side, from the SQL database on Azure up through the API, and you also build the React and TypeScript screens that sit on top.

AI coding tools draft most of the specs, tests and migrations. You direct them, read every diff line by line, and answer for what merges. If you'd rather write most of the code by hand, this probably isn't the right seat.

You report to the studio's leadership and work day to day with the lead developer and the product manager, who sets the acceptance criteria for each sprint. Success means delivering four to five features per two-week sprint, each verified before merge, and owning one area end to end (such as the task engine or the legacy migration) without breaking a live feature.

### You Bring

- 4+ years building full-stack web applications and releasing them to production
- Experience working in a codebase you didn't write, learning its conventions before changing it
- Hands-on work on workflow software where different user roles see different data, with approvals, task queues or state machines and an audit log or versioned history
- React, TypeScript and SQL on Azure, including schema design and migrations
- Daily use of Cursor, Claude Code or a similar AI coding tool on production work, with tests and CI behind it
- Clear written and spoken English
- Experience delivering in fixed-scope sprints with branches, code review and feature flags

### Bonus Points

- Work in a regulated setting such as finance, health or insurance
- A migration from a legacy system, with reconciliation and duplicate review
- Time as an outside vendor committing to a client's repo
- Project rules, custom prompts or agent setups for AI coding tools that your team adopted
- Spanish, since the platform is bilingual

### What's Offered

- Fully remote contractor role from LATAM, full time at about 40 hours a week
- Core hours in US time zones, so your day overlaps with the lead developer and the product manager
- An area of the product to own end to end, with your schema designs reviewed by the lead developer and the client's engineers
- A team where AI-first delivery is already the daily routine, with tests, CI and feature flags as part of the normal process
- A start in early November

### Interview Process

1. Intro Call: 30 minutes with atomic HR on your background and goals
2. Leadership Screening: A short call, possibly with an async part first
3. Product and Developer Conversation: How you take features from acceptance criteria to merge
4. Take-Home Test: One feature like the real scope, built and checked
